title: Front Office Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Hotel Harmony Inn is a modern hospitality property committed to delivering comfortable, well-managed stays for guests traveling for business or leisure. The hotel focuses on attentive service, clean and well-maintained facilities, and a welcoming environment for guests and team members. Staff are encouraged to uphold professional standards, collaborate across departments, and contribute to an efficient, guest-centric operation. Team members can expect a structured work setting with opportunities to develop their hospitality and leadership skills.
  
**Role Description**
The Front Office Manager is responsible for overseeing daily front desk operations to ensure smooth check-in and check-out experiences and consistent guest satisfaction. This full-time, on-site role is based in Meerut and includes supervising front office staff, managing reservations, handling guest inquiries and escalations, and coordinating with housekeeping and other departments. The role involves monitoring lobby activities, maintaining accurate guest records, preparing front office reports, and ensuring compliance with hotel policies and procedures. The Front Office Manager will also train team members, optimize staffing schedules, and support continuous improvement of service standards and operational efficiency.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Front Office and Office Administration skills, including supervising desk operations and managing reservations.
* Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction skills, with the ability to handle guest concerns and create positive guest experiences.
* Effective Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication with guests and team members.
* Previous experience in hotel front office or hospitality management roles.
* Ability to lead and motivate a team, organize workloads, and manage time effectively.
* Proficiency with hotel management or reservation systems and basic computer applications.
* Availability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, as required by hotel operations.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management or a related field is preferred.

title: Loan Manager – Assets
description:
**Company Description**
atyati Technologies, founded in 2006, is a financial technology company delivering comprehensive banking and financial services through a proprietary GANASEVA platform. With 100 offices and over 1,000 team members, atyati supports 21 banking and financial institutions and handles significant transaction volumes and advances every month. The organization plays a key role in financial inclusion across 27 states, serving millions of customers through Bank Mitras, CSPs, and doorstep banking solutions. atyati’s technology seamlessly integrates with core banking systems, offering services from financial transactions to credit and lending for rural, semi-urban, and urban customers. Its solutions are trusted by public sector banks, private banks, small finance banks, and institutions in India and Africa.
  
**Role Description**
The Loan Manager – Assets is a full-time, on-site role based in Sardhana, responsible for overseeing asset-based lending operations and portfolio performance. The role involves managing the end-to-end loan servicing cycle, including application review, documentation verification, disbursement coordination, and monitoring of repayment schedules. The Loan Manager will regularly analyze loan portfolios, track asset quality, and implement risk mitigation measures while ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines. Daily responsibilities include engaging with customers to address queries, resolving issues, coordinating with branch and field teams, and supporting collection activities where required. The role also involves preparing operational reports, identifying opportunities to improve processes, and contributing to business growth in the local market.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of Loan Servicing and Loans, including end-to-end lifecycle management and compliance with lending policies.
* Experience in Finance and Portfolio Management, with the ability to assess credit risk, monitor asset quality, and optimize portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated Customer Service skills, with a focus on clear communication, issue resolution, and relationship management.
* Previous experience in asset-based lending, retail or MSME lending, or related financial services roles.
* Understanding of banking and NBFC operations, especially in rural or semi-urban markets, is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field; relevant certifications in lending or credit management are beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Sardhana, collaborate with field teams, and manage multiple priorities with attention to detail.
* Proficiency with basic office software and loan management systems; familiarity with digital financial platforms is preferred.

title: Senior Site Engineer - Commercial
company: Alteora : Business Consulting | HR Consulting | IT Recruitments
description:
**Senior Site Engineer : Commercial & High Rise Construction**

**Location:**
Assigned sites across Meerut and the Meerut region, Uttar Pradesh

**Employment:**
Full-time and on-site; inter-site travel as assigned

**Experience:**
Minimum 5 years to 15 years of relevant hands-on site execution, with proven work-front, contractor and junior-team leadership

**Qualification:**
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering

**Reporting:**
GM/Project Manager or designated project lead

**Joining:**
Immediate preferred; maximum notice period 15-20 days

**Compensation:**
To be finalised by management for the respective grade, based on relevant experience and capability

**Role purpose**

Lead assigned commercial-building work fronts and supervise junior engineers, contractors and labour teams. Ensure accurate civil execution, strong MEP coordination, disciplined labour deployment and completion of assigned structural and finishing works to approved drawings, quality standards and schedules. Maintain complete daily reporting and strict accountability for preventing material wastage and pilferage.

**Mandatory technical requirements**

• Relevant experience in multistorey commercial or high-rise building construction; independently read architectural, structural and coordinated service GFC drawings.

• Strong RCC execution knowledge covering excavation, foundations, reinforcement, BBS, formwork, staging, concreting, curing and dimensional checks.

• Practical MEP coordination capability: electrical, plumbing, drainage, HVAC and firefighting interfaces, including sleeves, openings, shafts, embedded items and service clearances.

• Proven on-site labour handling: allocate work, check attendance and trade-wise deployment, monitor output, enforce discipline and resolve execution constraints.

• Working knowledge of finishing sequences, waterproofing, masonry and civil-MEP interfaces; competent in auto-level use, setting-out checks, Excel and AutoCAD.

• Demonstrated independent work-front planning, contractor coordination, technical problem-solving, quantity verification and supervision of junior engineers; support experience with project examples and references.

**Senior Site Engineer responsibilities**

• Supervise reinforcement, shuttering, cover, laps, anchorage, alignment and pre-pour inspections; record clearances before concrete placement.

• Control concrete receipt, placement, vibration, sampling, curing and construction joints; coordinate slump/cube tests and maintain traceable quality records.

• Resolve civil-MEP interfaces before pours, wall closure and finishes; obtain approved clarification for clashes and prohibit unauthorised cutting of structural members.

• Sequence civil, MEP, waterproofing and finishing trades; protect completed works and close snags within assigned deadlines.

• Deploy labour by activity and trade; verify daily attendance and output, monitor subcontractor commitments and escalate shortages or persistent underperformance.

• Own weekly look-ahead plans and daily targets; coordinate drawings, materials, labour and equipment, allocate work to juniors and contractors, and drive recovery of delays.

• Verify junior engineers' measurements, quality checks and material reconciliations; review contractor bills and variations against approved scope before recommending certification.

**Daily reporting and material accountability**

• Daily reporting is mandatory. Submit a signed DPR by the site-prescribed cut-off every working day, recording planned versus achieved quantities, labour and equipment deployment, inspections/tests, safety issues, constraints and the next day's plan.

• Maintain daily opening stock, receipts, authorised issues, actual consumption, returns, recoverable scrap and closing stock for materials under assigned control. Reconcile against executed quantities and approved consumption norms; explain every variance.

• Enforce a zero material wastage and zero pilferage requirement. Prevent over-issue, misuse, unauthorised removal, damage and avoidable loss through controlled storage, documented issues/returns and gate-pass checks with stores/security.

• Record any unavoidable process loss or approved allowance transparently; never conceal losses, manipulate consumption records or adjust stock without authorisation. Report suspected theft, shortages or unexplained variances immediately and support investigation and corrective action.

**Quality safety and selection standards**

Maintain approved drawing revisions, inspection records, test results, measurements and photographic evidence. Stop non-conforming or unsafe work and escalate promptly. Performance will be assessed on schedule delivery, quality, labour/equipment productivity, complete daily reports and traceable material control. No unexplained material variance or unreported loss is acceptable.

Screen out candidates below the stated experience minimum, without relevant field execution, unable to demonstrate the mandatory technical skills, unwilling to work on-site, or unwilling to accept daily reporting and material accountability. Assessment includes drawing interpretation, quantities/material reconciliation and labour planning, plus a civil-MEP coordination and pre-pour case.

**Application and work arrangements**

Apply to recruiter@alteora.in or call +91-7007043608. Share CV, preferred profile/grade, relevant projects and responsibilities, current location, current/expected compensation and notice period. Site hours, weekly rest, leave and any relocation/accommodation support will be confirmed in employment terms.

The Banquet Manager at The Narayan Farms oversees the planning, coordination, and execution of events and banquets held at the property. This full-time, on-site role is based in Meerut and involves managing day-to-day operations including event setup, staff scheduling, floor supervision during events, and post-event wrap-up. The Banquet Manager communicates with clients to understand event requirements, prepares function sheets, coordinates with kitchen and service teams, and ensures that all arrangements meet quality and safety standards. The role includes monitoring service quality, resolving guest concerns in real time, managing inventory of banquet supplies, and maintaining cleanliness and order in event spaces. The Banquet Manager also supports budgeting and cost control for events, trains and mentors banquet staff, and helps implement best practices to improve efficiency and guest satisfaction.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong event and banquet operations skills, including planning, coordination, and on-site supervision of functions.
* Proficiency in team leadership, staff scheduling, and training to ensure consistent service standards.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills for interacting with clients, guests, and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and handle multiple events or preparations simultaneously.
* Basic knowledge of food and beverage service standards, hygiene practices, and safety protocols.
* Experience in hospitality, event management, or a similar role in hotels, resorts, or banquet venues is highly beneficial.
* Comfort with using basic office tools and event documentation (e.g., function sheets, checklists, reports).
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a calm approach under pressure.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays based on event schedules.
* A diploma or degree in hospitality management, event management, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Front Office Manager (m/w/d) - Studentjob.at
description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung
   

  

**Unser Herz schlägt türkis.**
 Arbeiten bei Motel One ist wie zu Freunden kommen, wo Wertschätzung und Unterstützung großgeschrieben werden und die individuelle Persönlichkeit willkommen ist. Wir begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe und verstehen uns als ein Team: von der Geschäftsführung bis zu den Auszubildenden.
   

  

 Mit unserer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für modernes Design und hohe Servicequalität schaffen wir für unsere Gäste bei Motel One ein Zuhause für unterwegs. Unsere mehr als 104 Hotels in 14 Ländern überzeugen mit exklusivem Design, hohen Servicestandards und erstklassigen innerstädtischen Standorten zu einem attraktiven Preis.
   

  

 Als Begründer und Vorreiter des Budget Design Konzepts expandieren wir erfolgreich in den Metropolen Europas und darüber hinaus. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns Motel One.
   

  

 Stellenbeschreibung
   

  

 Als Front Office Manager (m/w/d) sorgst du mit deinem Gespür für Menschen und deiner Präsenz am Empfang dafür, dass sich unsere Gäste vom ersten Moment an willkommen fühlen.
   

  

 Dabei führst du dein Team mit Empathie sowie Klarheit und schaffst ein motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld. Dein Anspruch: ein reibungsloser Ablauf am Front Office – von der Anreise bis zum Check\-out – und ein professioneller Auftritt, der Gäste nachhaltig begeistert.
   

  

 Darüber hinaus zählt zu deinen Aufgaben:
   

  

  

* Durchführung von Check\-Ins sowie Prüfung der Reservierungen, Überbuchungen und Optionen
* Überwachung der Kosten\- und des Logis\-Erlösbudgets
* Sicherstellung der Qualitätsstandards sowie Pflege des Qualitätsmanagementsystems
* Erstellung der Dienst\- und Urlaubspläne
* Einarbeitung, Motivation und Führung des Empfangsteams
* Durchführung von internen Coachings, Cross Trainings und Planung von Schulungen zur Weiterentwicklung der Front Office Mitarbeitenden
* Entwicklung der Auszubildenden
* enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Reservierung und Sales


 Qualifikationen
   

  

 Du übernimmst gern Verantwortung und bist ein Vorbild? Persönlichkeit und ausgeprägte Gastgeberqualitäten zeichnen dich aus? \- Du passt zu uns! Denn das steht bei uns an erster Stelle!
   

  

 Außerdem bringst du mit:
   

  

  

* Ausbildung im Hotelfach bzw. Mind. 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Hotellerie / Gastronomie oder Interesse an einem Quereinstieg (zum Beispiel mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung als Teamleitung im Servicebereich)
* Freude an der Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden und erste Führungserfahrung erforderlich
* Gastgeberqualitäten und Leidenschaft für die Hotellerie sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Serviceorientierung
* Offenes, kommunikatives Auftreten, gute Umgangsformen sowie eine gute Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch \& Englisch (Wort \& Schrift)
* Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft abteilungsübergreifend zu unterstützen – Wir erreichen unsere Erfolge gemeinsam

title: Site Admin
description:
APM Terminals
   

  

 Lead end\-to\-end admin operations, ensuring day\-to\-day management of admin activities, team workflow coordination, provider onboarding, documentation compliance, and smooth operational execution. Assist in planning new initiatives and programmes while managing admin operations in line with applicable codes of practice and Maersk ethos. Utilize operational metrics and data analysis to enhance team efficiency, improve SLA compliance, and support effective decision\-making.
   

  

**Admin Asset \& Infrastructure Management:** 
 Organize the end\-to\-end admin asset lifecycle, including maintenance of admin assets and infrastructure, implementation of automated tracking systems, and reduction of Time\-to\-Repair/replacement.
   

  

**Performance Optimization:** 
 Utilized data analytics to identify skill gaps, design targeted training programmes, increase manpower productivity, ensure optimal deployment, and enable cost\-effective usage of materials, manpower and equipment. Drive Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) initiatives for admin assets: Usage optimization, cost benchmarking, AMC \& contract rationalization. Identify and execute cost\-saving projects (₹/move impact). Build MIS for: Maintenance cost trends and Cost per equipment.
   

  

**Policy Implementation \& Compliance:** 
 Standardized admin policy documentation and compliance procedures, maintained all required documents including logbooks, ensured adherence to SOPs, supported regulatory compliance, and implemented best practices across admin operations.
   

  

**Reporting \& Controls:** 
 Generated weekly metrics and statutory reports on admin operations, maintained systems for receipt and dispatch of goods, and ensured effective stock control of housekeeping, stationery, and other admin\-related items procured for the site.
   

  

**Vendor, Contract \& SLA Management:** 
 Optimized vendor contract negotiations, ensured timely contract renewals for admin services, maintained contracts, documents, warranty certificates and claims, enabled timely vendor payments, and ensured cab service SLA compliance while maintaining high\-quality operational support.
   

  

**Housekeeping, Safety \& Site Administration:** 
 Established and implemented effective housekeeping practices at site, ensured all admin\-related activities were performed as per safety norms, and supported overall site administration through structured processes and continuous monitoring.
   

  

**Education – Postgraduate, Preferred \- MBA**
